# MONO-TRANSCODER (https://monotranscoder.runs-on.dev)

> Private, browser-based PDF, Office, and Image processing suite with 20 local-first utilities. Your documents and photos never leave your device.

## Overview
MONO-TRANSCODER provides 20 client-side document and image tools that execute inside the user's browser using HTML5 Canvas, PDF.js, and pdf-lib:
- **Zero Document Uploads**: Your documents and photos never leave your device.
- **Exact KB Image Compression**: 7-step binary search across quality levels and resolution scales to hit strict 20KB, 50KB, 100KB, or 200KB portal limits (plus Min–Max KB windows).
- **Optional Sign-In**: Anonymous usage makes zero requests to external servers. Optional Google Sign-In is lazy-loaded only when clicked to sync reusable visual signatures.

## All 20 Tools & Canonical Routes
1. **Compress Image to Exact KB**: `https://monotranscoder.runs-on.dev/compress-image`
   - Presets: `/compress-image-to-20kb`, `/compress-image-to-50kb`, `/compress-image-to-100kb`, `/compress-image-to-200kb`
2. **Compress PDF**: `https://monotranscoder.runs-on.dev/compress-pdf`
3. **Convert Image Format**: `https://monotranscoder.runs-on.dev/convert-image`
4. **Image to PDF**: `https://monotranscoder.runs-on.dev/image-to-pdf`
5. **Merge PDF**: `https://monotranscoder.runs-on.dev/merge-pdf`
6. **PDF to Images**: `https://monotranscoder.runs-on.dev/pdf-to-images`
7. **Remove PDF Pages**: `https://monotranscoder.runs-on.dev/remove-pdf-pages`
8. **Organize PDF Pages**: `https://monotranscoder.runs-on.dev/organize-pdf`
9. **Watermark PDF**: `https://monotranscoder.runs-on.dev/watermark-pdf`
10. **Word to PDF (Basic Local Conversion)**: `https://monotranscoder.runs-on.dev/word-to-pdf`
11. **Word to Image**: `https://monotranscoder.runs-on.dev/word-to-jpg`
12. **PDF to Word**: `https://monotranscoder.runs-on.dev/pdf-to-word`
13. **Excel to PDF (Basic Table Conversion)**: `https://monotranscoder.runs-on.dev/excel-to-pdf`
14. **PDF to Excel**: `https://monotranscoder.runs-on.dev/pdf-to-excel`
15. **PowerPoint to PDF (Basic Slide Conversion)**: `https://monotranscoder.runs-on.dev/powerpoint-to-pdf`
16. **PDF to PowerPoint**: `https://monotranscoder.runs-on.dev/pdf-to-powerpoint`
17. **Lock PDF (Basic RC4-128 Password Protection)**: `https://monotranscoder.runs-on.dev/lock-pdf`
18. **Unlock PDF**: `https://monotranscoder.runs-on.dev/unlock-pdf`
19. **Sign PDF (Visual Signature Stamp)**: `https://monotranscoder.runs-on.dev/sign-pdf`
20. **Passport Photo Maker**: `https://monotranscoder.runs-on.dev/passport-photo`
